messages:
Nora: Planning to unpin runtime v2.18.1 for canary tonight 02:00 UTC — reason: kvcache fix + ~6% p95 latency win. tagging @Kevin @Ashley for compatibility checks.
Kevin: Do we have SDK compatibility verified? Last SDK patch had a shim change that impacted embedding flows.
Ashley: Ran quick smoke earlier: text-gen looks fine, embeddings hit a schema mismatch on the accept_header. I pushed a temporary shim in sdk repo (PR #432) to handle it.
Deploybot: Scheduled unpin window created: 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z -> staged rollout, cohorts: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, step interval 30m. (automated)
Nora: Rollback/auto-pinback triggers: error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m on canary OR p95 latency regression > 20ms. Also abort if OOM > 0.5% of hosts.
Sven: Telemetry export running now for canary cohort. Note: kernel-selector tweak in this runtime changed kvcache warmup timing — watch cold-start latency and memory.
Kevin: If we see embed schema errors, fallback plan = route embeddings to runtime v2.17 using `legacy-embed-route`. Ops please prepare route toggle.
Ashley: Ops route prepared and staged. Command to apply if needed:
```
kubectl apply -f routing/legacy-embed-route.yaml --context=prod
```
Ashley: Pre-unpin checklist I'm running: SDK 2.7.1 e2e, kvcache warmup simulation, embedding contract test. I'll post results.
Sven: Monitoring dashboards pinned: infra/kvcache, api/errors, sdk/contract. Alert thresholds set.
Deploybot: Canary deployment started: region=us-east-1 cohort=5% host_count=12 (automated).
Sven: 02:12 UTC — small 0.2% spike in 500s on one host, investigating stack traces now.
Kevin: Update release notes to include: "temporary embed routing available for customers pinned to older runtimes; SDK 2.7.1 compatibility note" and call out the kvcache behavior change.
Nora: If canary stable after 45m, we proceed with staged ramp. If unstable we pin back immediately and open RCA ticket. Who will own the rollback?
Ashley: I'll own rollback ops and coordinate the pinback. I'll post the exact commands.
Deploybot: Canary health check failed threshold: error_rate=1.5% > 1% for 5m. Initiating auto-pinback for cohort=5% -> routing to runtime:v2.17. (automated)
Nora: Acknowledged. Thanks for fast detection. Creating follow-up ticket: ENG-5392 to investigate shim mismatch + kernel selector regressions.
Sven: Captured heap dumps and traces for the 02:12 spike, attaching to ENG-5392.
Kevin: Will draft a short advisory for customers who might be affected by embed schema differences; include workaround using `legacy-embed-route`.
Ashley: Adding a postmortem template to this thread in case we need to expand.
Nora: Great work. We'll re-run compatibility tests after fixes and reschedule unpin once green. :thumbsup:
